start: Gym tab, joined gym with the shop on, one order placed and still Ordered

steps.action: Tap the bag, place an order; My orders opens
user_sees: Card 'Order <n>' with the time, pill 'Ordered', 'The gym is getting it ready', items and total
must_not: The green line over a cancelled card
Total different from the bag without a word

steps.action: Wait on the page while the desk marks it ready
user_sees: Within about 10 seconds the pill turns 'Ready' and 'Collect it at the desk'
must_not: A 'Cancel order' button on a Ready order
The page jumping back to the top on each refresh

start: My orders, an order the desk has just moved on

steps.action: Tap 'Cancel order', then 'Cancel order' in 'Cancel this order?'
user_sees: Then 'The gym has already moved this order on, so it can no longer be cancelled here. Ask at the desk.' under the card
must_not: The order shown as cancelled when the gym refused
Two cancel calls from a double tap

steps.action: Open My orders with no orders
user_sees: 'No orders yet' and 'Orders you place in your gym's shop show here.'
must_not: A blank page or an endless spinner

start: My orders, an order cancelled by the member and another by the gym

steps.action: Cancel an Ordered order and keep the page open
must_not: The order back to Ordered on the next 10-second refresh

steps.action: Look at an order the desk cancelled
must_not: 'You cancelled this order' for the gym's cancel

start: Gym tab, 'My orders' row (not from the bag), no internet

steps.action: Open My orders from the row, then pull down
user_sees: The orders the phone kept, and a quiet line that the list could not be refreshed
must_not: An empty list that looks like 'No orders yet'
A crash on the pull

start: My orders, two members of the same gym on two phones

must_not: Another member's order, name or total
